description: Defines classes and methods for executing control actions related to E2SM RIC control in a DU context, including base and derived executor classes with specific implementations.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_action_du_executor_base
classes.description: Base class for executing E2SM RIC control actions related to DU, providing common interface and members.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_action_2_6_du_executor
classes.description: Derived class implementing specific control action execution logic for a particular RIC control action (2.6).

methods.name: get_control_action_definition
methods.description: Returns the control action definition for the executor.

methods.name: get_action_id
methods.description: Returns the action ID associated with the control action.

methods.name: get_action_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the control action.

methods.name: ric_control_action_supported
methods.description: Checks if a given RIC control request is supported by this executor.

methods.name: execute_ric_control_action
methods.description: Executes the RIC control action asynchronously.

methods.name: return_ctrl_failure
methods.description: Returns a failure response for control actions.

methods.name: parse_action_ran_parameter_value
methods.description: Parses RAN parameter value and updates control configuration.

methods.name: convert_to_du_config_request
methods.description: Converts RIC control request to DU MAC scheduling control configuration.

methods.name: convert_to_e2sm_response
methods.description: Converts DU control configuration response to E2SM RIC control response.
